readingUncertainties: The Act column is blank on every flight row; the operator appears to use a code only for non-flying activities, so the flight duties are recorded with no code rather than with a code I failed to read.
The header's 'Reservas: 2' is the count of standby days; nothing on the page states whether the 30/10 and 01/11 windows are airport or home standby, so I have recorded them simply as standby at MAD.

derivations.method: Fin printed as 12:20+1; the +1 taken as 13/10 and the clock read as MAD local (the arrival station of TL374), then converted
Fin printed as 00:20+1; read as 12/10 00:20 JFK local, the arrival station, then converted
Reporte 05:40 printed on the first of four same-date rows and applied to the whole duty; the three continuation rows carry no report of their own
Fin 03:40+1 read as 25/10 03:40 MAD local, which falls after Spain's 03:00 CEST to 02:00 CET switchback that morning, so converted at UTC+1 rather than +2
Fin 06:55+1 read as 28/10 06:55 MAD local, post-DST-change, converted at UTC+1
Fin 03:40+1 read as 05/11 03:40 MAD local, converted at UTC+1
Fin 06:05+1 read as 08/11 06:05 MAD local, converted at UTC+1
